change: adds the client's own per-attempt wall-clock ceiling abort message to the enumerated benign-transient set, anchored on its full application-generated shape
evidence: 10 occurrences on the main run through 2026-08-11T02:32Z, all google/gemma-4-31B-it, durations 1282s to 1638s against the 1200s ceiling, all during the same Together degradation window as amendments 12's chunked-read closures and the silent open-connection hang.
why_benign: The message is not a provider error at all: it is this codebase's own defense-in-depth abort, which by design counts the overlong call as a permanently-tracked unknown_charge and makes retry safe. Treating the mechanism's successful firing as an anomaly inverts its purpose.
why_this_is_not_a_widening: The anchored shape is generated by rejudge/api_client.py, so no provider string can ever match it. Only the attempt number, model name, and measured duration vary. A test asserts that a rephrased or re-valued ceiling message still stops the run, so a future code change to the ceiling must re-earn its enumeration.
recorded_by: session orchestrator (Claude Fable 5) under the owner's standing operational delegation, following the amendment-10 pattern
what_it_does_not_relax: nothing else. The ceiling itself is unchanged and still converts every overlong call to unknown_charge; the same-call limit still catches a deterministic overlong loop; the uncertain ceiling still bounds the accumulated ambiguity.
note: Append-only. Grants no authority and changes no cap.
